title: fix: refresh sidebar balance after quest claims
author: ale-rls

gist.summary: After a successful Quest claim, QuestOverview revalidates the dashboard loader so the sidebar Pollen balance reflects the credited reward without navigation or a page reload. The refresh starts before quest data reloads, so a failed list request does not prevent the balance update. Claim errors and the existing quest-navigation update event are preserved; failed claims do not refresh the balance.
